title: Ebola outbreak in Africa
summary: A Bundibugyo-strain outbreak that began in the Democratic Republic of Congo in May, with no licensed vaccine or treatment, has passed 9,500 cases and 4,600 deaths. Kenya has nine cases linked to one imported patient, and on 20 October Nigeria confirmed its first case, a traveller in Abuja with 44 contacts under watch.

background.text: Outbreak detected in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
Kenya's first patient, who travelled from Congo, dies in Nairobi.
